"# AFTER THE FALL
### A Story-Driven Zombie Apocalypse Survival Game

**Genre:** 2.5D / 3D, Story-Driven Adventure, Survival Horror, Zombie Apocalypse, Exploration, Choices and Consequences.

**Visual Style:** A unique hand-drawn, comic-book-inspired art style combining detailed 3D environments with 2D artistic elements. The game features cel-shaded graphics, dark atmospheric colors, dramatic lighting, realistic shadows, and cinematic camera angles.

## The World

Six years have passed since civilization collapsed.

Once-thriving cities have become enormous graveyards of concrete, steel, and forgotten memories.

Skyscrapers stand partially destroyed, apartment buildings have collapsed, and entire neighborhoods lie buried beneath rubble. Streets are filled with abandoned vehicles, broken bridges, shattered windows, and the remains of a civilization that no longer exists.

Nature is slowly reclaiming the world. Trees grow through cracked roads, vines cover abandoned buildings, and thick vegetation spreads across empty streets.

Hospitals, schools, shopping malls, underground subway stations, and residential buildings have become dangerous places filled with infected creatures and hidden secrets.

The atmosphere is dark, lonely, emotional, and deeply immersive.

Humanity is on the edge of extinction.

Small groups of survivors struggle to stay alive. Some have created peaceful settlements, while others have become ruthless, dangerous, and willing to kill for food, medicine, and supplies.

But the infected are not the only monsters left in this world.

## Main Story

The player takes control of **Daniel, a 27-year-old survivor** who has spent the last six years searching for answers about his missing younger sister.

During the first days of the outbreak, Daniel and his sister were separated while attempting to escape their hometown.

For years, Daniel believed she was dead.

One day, while exploring an abandoned radio station, he discovers a mysterious transmission mentioning his sister's name.

For the first time in six years, he has a reason to believe she might still be alive.

Daniel begins a dangerous journey through destroyed cities, abandoned highways, forests, underground tunnels, military facilities, and forgotten settlements.

Throughout his journey, he meets other survivors, each with their own personalities, motivations, secrets, and tragic histories.

Some will become trusted companions.

Others will betray him.

And some will die because of the decisions the player makes.

As Daniel moves closer to the truth, he discovers disturbing information about the origins of the infection and the people responsible for the collapse of civilization.

## Gameplay Features

### Exploration and Environment

- Large, interconnected environments with semi-open-world exploration.
- Massive ruined cities filled with collapsed buildings and abandoned skyscrapers.
- Detailed interiors, including apartments, hospitals, schools, supermarkets, police stations, and underground shelters.
- Hidden rooms, secret passages, abandoned bunkers, and environmental storytelling.
- Dynamic weather, including rain, thunderstorms, fog, and snowfall.
- A complete day-and-night cycle.
- Atmospheric lighting and cinematic visual effects.

### Survival Mechanics

- Search abandoned buildings for food, water, medicine, weapons, and ammunition.
- Manage limited resources and inventory space.
- Craft basic survival equipment and tools.
- Use stealth to avoid dangerous infected enemies.
- Fight only when necessary, as ammunition is extremely limited.
- Explore dangerous locations to discover rare supplies and important story clues.

### Choices and Consequences

Player decisions have a significant impact on the story.

- Dialogue choices influence relationships with other survivors.
- Characters remember the player's actions.
- Trust and loyalty develop naturally over time.
- Important characters can permanently die.
- Certain decisions unlock or close entire s (3D Game, Phone/Tablet)

- Build a complete, playable mobile-friendly survival game titled “AFTER THE FALL,” based on Daniel’s search for his missing sister in a zombie apocalypse.

## Requirements
- 2.5D/3D-inspired, comic-book aesthetic with dark atmosphere and cinematic presentation.
- Include exploration, survival resources, infected, story dialogue, and choices with consequences.
- Support phone/tablet controls.
- No clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- User requested small JPEG screenshots for checks, viewport ≤1280px, reading only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Built a self-contained browser game using Canvas 2D and vanilla HTML/CSS/JS.
- Assumed a linear, playable chapter through a ruined city, with keyboard and touch controls.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created a title screen, HUD, responsive layouts, and mobile movement/action controls.
- Implemented procedurally drawn ruined-city scenery, rain, scavenging, health/stamina, infected, dialogue choices, objectives, pause, and basic audio toggle.
- `node --check game.js` passes.

### Active
- Validate the game in a browser and fix any runtime or visual defects.
- Consider a screenshot check; no screenshot has been captured yet.

- (none)

1. Inspect `style.css` syntax and launch the game in a browser.
2. Verify game start, movement, interactions, and mobile layout; fix defects.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game UI and overlays.
- `style.css`: Visual design and responsive styling.
- `game.js`: Rendering, gameplay logic, controls, and story.

## Objective
- Build “AFTER THE FALL,” a complete, playable, mobile-friendly zombie-apocalypse survival story game about Daniel searching for his missing sister.

- Comic-book-inspired, dark cinematic atmosphere with exploration, survival resources, infected, story dialogue, and consequential choices.
- Support phone/tablet controls; make reasonable assumptions without clarifying questions.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for checks, viewport ≤1280px wide, and inspect only the latest screenshot.

- Implemented as a self-contained browser game using Canvas 2D and vanilla HTML/CSS/JS.
- Set the playable chapter in a ruined city, with keyboard and touch controls.
